company.name: Rune Technologies
company.shortDescription: Rune Technologies develops AI-enabled predictive logistics solutions for military operations.
company.description: Rune Technologies develops TyrOS, an AI-enabled predictive logistics platform designed for military and contested environments. The platform connects, organizes, and analyzes critical sustainment information, providing real-time data-driven decisions for logistics and sustainment systems. It offers intelligent planning, decision support, and predictive analytics to enhance precision, agility, and efficiency in supply operations.

productsAndServices.description: A logistics software platform that integrates and analyzes sustainment data to support real-time decision-making in military logistics operations.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-enabled predictive military logistics platform that ingests force data to track assets, anticipate shortfalls, and provide real-time sustainment visibility in contested environments.
